## Quick Start

State installation, hardware, checkpoint access, and data requirements. From the
repository root, launch at least one checked-in recipe for this checkpoint:

```bash
uv run automodel examples/llm_finetune/MODEL/MODEL_squad.yaml --nproc-per-node 8
```

Use the recipe's documented Python entry point when it has no `recipe` target.
For multiple nodes, show the cluster launch command and its required topology.
Every card must have a recipe; setup prose alone does not satisfy Quick Start.
